briefing: Good morning! ☀️ The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services has frozen all child care funding to Minnesota due to fraud allegations, affecting over 30,000 families. Aimee Bock, founder of Feeding Our Future, has been ordered to pay $5.2 million in restitution. Investigations into daycare fraud and public assistance programs are ongoing, with the House Oversight Committee set to hold a hearing.
